items.title: Exchange Rates & the UK Trade Balance
items.summary: Did a weaker pound help UK goods trade between 2015 and 2025? A decade of monthly data, tested with robust econometrics.
points: Brexit was the dominant driver of the deficit: −£6,117m a month (p<0.001), 18 times the currency effect.
Confirmed J-curve dynamics: the REER was insignificant at 0–1 months, with transmission peaking at six months (−£138m, p=0.017).
Cumulative long-run REER effect of −£443m a month (p<0.001), while COVID-19 was statistically absorbed (p=0.808).
